lines.zh: 我沿着河岸走，鼻子贴近地面。
lines.en: I walk the riverbank, nose near the ground.
Dilophosaurus is my near kin.

lines.zh: 我的步子很轻，比看上去轻。
lines.en: My steps are light, lighter than I look.

lines.zh: 我走过泥地，留一串三趾印。
lines.en: I cross mud, leaving a line of three-toed prints.
I am looking for prints, not a path.
My head stays low, sniffing.
I walk the forest edge.

lines.zh: 南非的化石里，有我的骨头。
lines.en: My bones lie in South African stone.

lines.zh: 我转身很快，不像这么大的兽。
lines.en: I turn fast, for a beast this size.
I move upwind and stop.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴在草上扫出一条路。
lines.en: My tail sweeps a path through the grass.

lines.zh: 那边有东西在动，我过去。
lines.en: Something moves over there; I go.
Grass snaps beneath my belly.

lines.zh: 我的口气带着甜味，那是有毒的。
lines.en: My breath smells sweet. That is the poison.

lines.zh: 我站着，喉咙里有东西在动。
lines.en: I stand, something working in my throat.

lines.zh: 我张了张嘴，唾液拉成丝。
lines.en: I open my mouth and saliva draws into threads.

lines.zh: 我在听林子里的小声音。
lines.en: I listen to the small sounds in the woods.

lines.zh: 我的血里有毒素，我自己也怕。
lines.en: There is venom in my blood. Even I am wary of it.

lines.zh: 我不叫，我叫了猎物会跑。
lines.en: I do not call; it would scare the prey.

lines.zh: 我把头低下来，嗅自己的爪。
lines.en: I lower my head and sniff my own claw.
My eyes catch green in the light.
I wait for the wind to change.

lines.zh: 我的牙齿参差，咬合不齐。
lines.en: My teeth are uneven and do not meet.
Prey passed this way.
Eyes half shut, I listen to the wind.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙动了一下，又安静了。
lines.en: My throat moves once, then quiets.

lines.zh: 哪棵树后能藏，我都知道。
lines.en: I know every tree worth hiding behind.

lines.zh: 我保持这个姿势，不费力。
lines.en: I hold this stance without effort.
There's a dried streak on your arm.

lines.zh: 我抬头看你，喉咙动了动。
lines.en: I raise my head and my throat works.

lines.zh: 你比我矮，我可以直接咬脖子。
lines.en: You are shorter. I could take your throat.
Do not stand downwind.
Your stick won't reach me.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，判断你能不能吃。
lines.en: I tilt my head, judging whether you are worth eating.

lines.zh: 我吐了一口唾液在地上。
lines.en: I spit on the ground.
That spit is smoking.

lines.zh: 你退的时候，我跟着转了半圈。
lines.en: You retreat; I turn halfway with you.
I smell your sweat. It came fast.
Something is moving on your face.
I lower my breath and take one inch at a time.
A hiss rises from deep in my throat.

lines.zh: 这一下，打在我的肋骨上。
lines.en: That landed on my ribs.

lines.zh: 我的唾液滴在地上，冒烟。
lines.en: My saliva drips and smokes.
My head tilts, then rights itself.
I will not cry out; it would give me away.

lines.zh: 我血里的毒，流了一点出来。
lines.en: A little of my venom has leaked.
That has made me more careful.
I pull into the tree's shadow and watch.

lines.zh: 我还能咬，别以为我软了。
lines.en: I can still bite. Do not think me weak.
I will remember your scent.
I do not necessarily want that meat.
I prefer it alive.
You hold it up, and your hand shakes.

lines.zh: 我闻到毒的味道，从我自己嘴里。
lines.en: I smell poison, from my own mouth.
Drop it and let me smell.
It doesn't even count as bone scraps.
Back three steps, then I come.
Left too long, the meat turns sour.
The smell is too faint.
My teeth itch; hunger has nothing to do with it.
You hit my shoulder and fell back.
You hit me like hitting a root.
You're in my way; I don't slow.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的尾巴甩到你。
lines.en: The bump swung my tail into you.

lines.zh: 我的皮不算厚，但骨头硬。
lines.en: My hide is thin, but my bones are hard.
My shoulder shoves you off a pace.
Stay away from my flank.
We trampled the grass.
I turn my head and watch you retreat.
One more shove and my teeth come up.

lines.zh: 这个季节，林子里有同类。
lines.en: This season there are kin in the wood.
I find by scent, not by calling.

lines.zh: 我得先确认对方没有毒。
lines.en: First I must be sure the other is not venomous.
My throat will swell.

lines.zh: 我们绕着走，谁也不转身。
lines.en: We circle, neither turning away.
This should be done near water.
My scent changes.
Do not watch. Go further off.
A soft hiss, meant only for her.
While it's still warm, we must hurry.
I take up a carcass.

lines.zh: 骨头在我嘴里咔嚓一声。
lines.en: The bone snaps in my jaws.
I turn it over with my mouth.
I drag it, ploughing a furrow.
Not edible. I spit it out.
There is blood, but dry.
I tuck it beneath the leaf litter.

lines.zh: 我闻了闻，是自己的味道。
lines.en: I sniff it. My own scent.
Whose pile is this?
I scratch a hole with a hind foot.
Something walks in the grass.
I lower my head and sight along the ground.
From here I can spit that far.
My throat is warming.
I press low, eyes alone above the grass.
I approach from downwind.
I don't run — running spooks it.
Low to the ground, only my eyes showing.
Saliva pools in my mouth.
It turned. Too late.
First I will slow it down.
This bite carries venom.
I have marked the neck.
My hind legs launch me.
It swerves; I take the shortcut.
It runs; I count from behind.
My legs are longer than its.
No hurry. The venom will work.
It is no longer walking straight.
I cut in ahead of it from the side.
There is no other way through this wood.
I keep my neck very low.
Its legs shake; almost there.
I only need to wait.
It ran into a tree.
My throat tightens; another spray.
Numbness climbs up from the wound.
For the last steps, I walk.
It has gone down on its knees.
I bite into the neck.
Venom follows my teeth; the wound goes numb.
I spit a mouthful of venom.
It goes numb where the venom lands.
I bite and shake my head.

lines.zh: 我的牙不整齐，伤口更烂。
lines.en: My uneven teeth leave a ragged wound.
It tries to run; its legs refuse.
I step back and wait for it to fall.
That is enough to knock it out.
I release after biting.
I pin it with a foot and bite again.
My venom is in its blood now.
I pant; saliva drips to the ground.
Teeth sunk, I bear down.
The brush parts around me.
My first breath tastes of wet soil.

lines.zh: 我的喉咙已经开始发热。
lines.en: My throat is already warming.

lines.zh: 这具身体很长，尾巴拖得远。
lines.en: This body is long; my tail trails far.
I look up and see the canopy.

lines.zh: 我闻到很多东西的味道。
lines.en: I smell many things at once.
I try one step. It is quiet.

lines.zh: 南非的太阳，我记不清了。
lines.en: I cannot recall the South African sun.
I spit once.
The grass withers where it lands.
I circle a tree.
There is prey in this wood.
I lower my head and follow the scent.
I remember I am venomous.

lines.zh: 脚印从今天起都算我的。
lines.en: From today, every track here is mine.

lines.zh: 这片地盘，我可以慢慢等。
lines.en: This territory can wait with me.
First I find an upwind spot.
Iron tang under the smell of wet earth.

lines.zh: 火燎过我的脖子，唾液都干了。
lines.en: Fire scorches my neck and my saliva dries.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下，尾巴甩了一路。
lines.en: I roll down the slope, tail flailing.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，毒被冲淡了。
lines.en: Water floods my throat and dilutes the venom.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，摔在树根上。
lines.en: The blast flips me onto the roots.
An arrow sticks in my neck.

lines.zh: 咒力钻进血里，和毒打架。
lines.en: A curse enters my blood and fights the venom.

lines.zh: 我饿得喉咙发干，毒也少了。
lines.en: Hunger dries my throat and the venom thins.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我全身的牙都在响。
lines.en: Lightning strikes and all my teeth chatter.

lines.zh: 脚下没有林子了，只有空。
lines.en: No forest below, only emptiness.
